### Quang Trach 1:
Located in Quang Binh Province, this 1,403 MW ultra-supercritical plant is larger than I initially thought. EVN owns it through EVNPMB2, with a consortium of Mitsubishi, Hyundai E&C, and Construction Corporation No.1 handling the EPC work.

Construction began in December 2021, and Unit 1 is nearing grid synchronization with first coal firing expected in May 2026. Unit 2 is currently undergoing testing after its reverse power input in February 2026. Phu My 1 is a 1,090 MW combined-cycle gas turbine facility with three 240 MW gas turbines and one 360 MW steam turbine, operated by EVNGENCO3.
